solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Written from right to left, old Indonesian language

indicators.note: text set down from right to left runs the opposite way to English, so the wordplay is read backwards

blocks.note: O is the standard abbreviation for old
a Javan is a native of Java, Indonesia's most populous island

explanation.surface: A note on an ancient Indonesian tongue that happens to be written right to left.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old Indonesian language' reads as one phrase, but the language is the definition and the rest is wordplay giving O JAVAN, reversed to NAVAJO.
explanation.definitionFit: Navajo is the Athabaskan tongue spoken by the Navajo people of the American Southwest.

clue.text: Specialist with logs put up a new platform

indicators.note: in a down clue, putting something up lifts it so it reads from bottom to top

blocks.note: taken as written
N is the abbreviation for new
a pier is a platform jutting out over the water

explanation.surface: A tree surgeon or lumberjack builds a fresh platform.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Logs' suggests timber, but here it means logarithms. A N is put up to give NA, then PIER follows.
explanation.definitionFit: John Napier, the Scottish mathematician, invented logarithms, so he is the expert in logs.

clue.text: Failing to drink round by bar that’s silent

indicators.note: drinking takes something inside, so one piece swallows the other

blocks.note: a vice is a moral failing
O is round in shape
bar and less both mean except, as in 'all bar one'

explanation.surface: Someone who has stopped drinking a round at the bar goes quiet.
explanation.walkthrough: VICE takes in O to make VOICE, and LESS is placed beside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that makes no sound is soundless, mute, without speech.

clue.text: Old Testament figure penning account for another

indicators.note: penning means shutting in, as animals are kept inside a pen

blocks.note: Job is the patient sufferer of the Old Testament book of that name
AC is the abbreviation for account

explanation.surface: A biblical figure writing a statement on behalf of someone else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Another' points back to 'Old Testament figure': JOB holds AC and becomes a different patriarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Jacob, son of Isaac and father of the twelve tribes, is a second Old Testament patriarch.

clue.text: Barbirolli’s lead is helpful for musicians

indicators.note: the lead of a word is its front, so only its opening letter is kept

blocks.note: Sir John Barbirolli was a British conductor
to assist is to help

explanation.surface: The conductor Barbirolli's leadership benefits the orchestra's players.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lead' suggests musical leadership, but it only asks for the opening letter of the conductor's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Bassists play bass guitar or double bass, so they are a kind of musician.

clue.text: One may have a reservation in diner, out to lunch with a maniac

indicators.note: someone out to lunch is crazy, so these letters are sent into a jumbled order

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone who has booked a table at a diner is out for lunch alongside a lunatic.
explanation.walkthrough: A reservation sounds like a restaurant booking, but here it is land set aside for a Native American nation.
explanation.definitionFit: In the US, reservations are territories held by Native American tribes, so a member of one may live on one.

clue.text: Downsizing personnel occupies founder over long period

indicators.note: whatever occupies a space sits inside it, so one piece goes within the other

blocks.note: to founder is to sink, as a ship does
HR, human resources, is the personnel department
an age is a long stretch of time

explanation.surface: A company founder lets HR run things during a long phase of cutbacks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Founder' looks like a company's creator; it is the verb meaning to go under. In a down clue, 'over' puts SHRINK above AGE.
explanation.definitionFit: Shrinkage is a reduction in size, which is what downsizing describes.

clue.text: Yankee boards transport that’s cut fare from Asia

indicators.note: something cut has been shortened, so the word loses its final letter
a passenger who boards goes inside the vessel, so one piece enters the other

blocks.note: a ship is a means of transport
a Yankee is an American, from the US

explanation.surface: An American gets on a vehicle whose cheap fare has been reduced.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fare' looks like the price of a ticket, fitting the transport picture, but it means food.
explanation.definitionFit: Sushi is a Japanese dish of vinegared rice with raw fish, a food from Asia.

clue.text: Way to separate characters in small pub ingesting speed

indicators.note: ingesting means taking in, so one piece is swallowed by the other

blocks.note: S is the abbreviation for small
a bar is a pub
pace is speed

explanation.surface: A little pub where somebody is taking the drug speed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Characters' are typed letters, not people, and 'small pub' is two pieces with the speed going in after the first.
explanation.definitionFit: On a keyboard the long key that inserts a blank keeps typed letters and words apart.

clue.text: Eccentric apprised of Cold War’s cause

indicators.note: eccentric means odd and off-centre, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: An oddball was told what started the Cold War.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cold War' looks like one phrase, but 'Cold' is part of the letters to rearrange and only 'War's cause' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Eris threw a golden apple among the goddesses, a dispute that led to the Trojan War.

clue.text: Royal imprisoning current extremists in powerful rule

indicators.note: the extremists of a word are its outermost letters, so only the two ends are kept
imprisoning locks something inside, so the other pieces go within the royal

blocks.note: a prince is a royal
I is the symbol for electric current
the first and last letters of the word

explanation.surface: A monarch locks up topical radicals under authoritarian rule.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Current' looks like an adjective meaning topical; it is the physics symbol for electric current.
explanation.definitionFit: A principle is a fundamental law or guiding precept, which is one sense of a rule.

clue.text: Maybe dreaded figure, one of the White Russians from the east

indicators.note: in an across clue, reading from the east means going right to left

blocks.note: a tsar: Russia's emperor was traditionally styled the White Tsar

explanation.surface: A feared person who belonged to the anti-Bolshevik White Russians.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dreaded' suggests feared, but means wearing dreadlocks; A TSAR read backwards gives RASTA.
explanation.definitionFit: Rastafarians often wear their hair in dreadlocks, so a Rasta is an example of a person with dreads.

clue.text: English setters one’s perhaps seen on a farm

definitions.text: one’s perhaps seen on a farm
definitions.note: a clause meaning 'one that is perhaps seen on a farm'

blocks.note: E is the abbreviation for English
setters speaking of themselves would say we

explanation.surface: English setter dogs, perhaps spotted on a farm.
explanation.walkthrough: English setters are a breed of dog, but here the setters are the puzzle compilers, who call themselves WE.
explanation.definitionFit: A ewe is a female sheep, a creature one would expect to find in farm fields.

clue.text: Holiday for jazz fans, hosting broadcasting mogul

indicators.note: a host has guests inside, so one piece contains the other

blocks.note: to jazz fans, Holiday is the singer Billie Holiday
a programme being broadcast is on air

explanation.surface: A media tycoon puts on a vacation festival for jazz enthusiasts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Holiday' looks like a vacation; it is the jazz singer's surname, giving her first name BILLIE.
explanation.definitionFit: A mogul is a powerful, very wealthy magnate, and a billionaire is such a rich person.

clue.text: What could fasten loose cover back on stool

indicators.note: the back of a word is its end, so only the final letter is used
loose letters are not held in place, so they can be rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written
the final letter of the word

explanation.surface: Something to secure a slipping cushion cover back onto a stool.
explanation.definitionFit: Velcro is a hook-and-loop fastener, used to close bags, shoes and clothing.

clue.text: Cuts of meat? Approve of what’s put in chow mein, maybe

definitions.text: what’s put in chow mein, maybe

blocks.note: chops are cuts of meat, such as lamb chops
to tick something is to mark it as approved

explanation.surface: A question about meat cuts and approval of what goes into a Chinese noodle dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put in' sounds like an ingredient, but the answer is what is put into the dish to eat it.
explanation.definitionFit: A chopstick is one of a pair of sticks dipped into a bowl of noodles to eat them.

clue.text: Sober people hosting party — mum’s in a state

indicators.note: a host has guests inside, so one piece contains the other

blocks.note: AA, Alcoholics Anonymous, is a group of people staying sober
Lab is short for the Labour Party
Ma is mother

explanation.surface: Teetotallers throw a party and mother is in a flap about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In a state' suggests being upset, but 'a state' is a US state; LAB, the Labour Party, is the UK political party.
explanation.definitionFit: Alabama is one of the fifty United States, in the American Deep South.

clue.text: Like a tie that’s uncool with a couple of lines on it

blocks.note: taken as written
L stands for line, and a couple means two
a square is someone old-fashioned and uncool

explanation.surface: An unfashionable necktie with a pair of stripes on it.
explanation.walkthrough: The tie is a drawn game, not a necktie. In a down clue, 'on it' places A LL above SQUARE.
explanation.definitionFit: When a match or contest is level, with neither side ahead, the scores are equal.

clue.text: Horse and zebras periodically escaping pounds

indicators.note: letters escaping at regular intervals leave every other one behind

blocks.note: horse and smack are both slang for heroin
the second, fourth and sixth letters

explanation.surface: A horse and some zebras breaking out of an animal pound.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pounds' looks like enclosures, but it is money; smackers is British slang for pounds sterling.
explanation.definitionFit: Smackers is informal British slang for pounds or dollars, as in 'it cost fifty smackers'.

clue.text: Beauty queen hasn’t succeeded, cutting line in phrase badly

indicators.note: not having something means it is missing, so a letter is dropped
cutting something removes it, so another letter goes

blocks.note: Miss World is the title of an international beauty-pageant winner
S is the abbreviation for succeeded, as in family trees
L is the abbreviation for line

explanation.surface: A beauty queen who failed in her bid gives a clumsy, cutting line.
explanation.walkthrough: MISS WORLD loses one S and its L to leave MISWORD.
explanation.definitionFit: To misword something is to express it in the wrong terms, so it is badly worded.

clue.text: Models of Apple’s business transactions?

blocks.note: Apple names products with a lower-case i, as in iPhone and iPad
deals are business transactions

explanation.surface: A question about the business models behind Apple's commercial dealings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Models' sounds like Apple's product range, but it means perfect examples to follow.
explanation.definitionFit: Ideals are standards of perfection, exemplars to copy, which is a sense of models.

clue.text: Brand using digital tech is to prove a winner

blocks.note: a make is a brand of product
IT, information technology, is digital tech

explanation.surface: A company that adopts computer technology is bound to succeed.
explanation.definitionFit: To make it is an idiom for achieving success, so it means turning out triumphant.

clue.text: Select players in wigs inspiring joyousness regularly

indicators.note: taking letters regularly means keeping every other one at an even pace
to inspire is literally to breathe in, so one piece is drawn inside the other

blocks.note: to wig someone is to scold them, an old-fashioned sense
the second, fourth, sixth, eighth and tenth letters

explanation.surface: Choosing cast members who wear wigs and radiate joy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wigs' looks like hairpieces; it is an old verb meaning to scold or tell off.
explanation.definitionFit: Before a playground game, two captains pick teams in turn from the available players.

clue.text: Three rings interwoven with very large moulding

indicators.note: interwoven strands are threaded through each other, so the letters are mixed together

blocks.note: each ring is an O, so three give three Os
V is the abbreviation for very
L is the abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: Three circles woven together with a huge decorative moulding.
explanation.walkthrough: The three Os alternate with V and L, like strands woven through each other.
explanation.definitionFit: An ovolo is a convex architectural moulding, roughly a quarter-circle in section.

clue.text: Flipping pasta sauces: dear!

indicators.note: flipping something over turns it the other way, so the word is read backwards

blocks.note: ragù is an Italian meat sauce served with pasta

explanation.surface: An exasperated cook's cry: blasted pasta sauces, oh dear!
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flipping' reads as a mild curse, and 'dear!' as an exclamation; it is a term of endearment.
explanation.definitionFit: Sugar is an affectionate name for a loved one, used like honey or sweetheart.

clue.text: Peer has no clothing, as coming from Rome

indicators.note: without clothing means stripped of the outer layer, so the outside letters go

blocks.note: a peer is an equal, someone of the same standing

explanation.surface: A nobleman goes naked in the manner of a Roman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Peer' looks like a lord; it means an equal, whose outer letters are stripped.
explanation.definitionFit: Qua is the Latin word meaning in the capacity of, so it is Rome's way of saying as.

clue.text: Priest holding firm is a cause of complaints

indicators.note: holding keeps something within, so one piece goes inside the other

blocks.note: Eli is the priest of the Old Testament who raised Samuel
Co is the abbreviation for company

explanation.surface: A clergyman who owns a business attracts grievances.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Complaints' sounds like grumbles, but here they are illnesses, as in a stomach complaint.
explanation.definitionFit: This bacterium is a common source of food poisoning and other illnesses, known as complaints.

clue.text: Poem about area east of Himalayas? It’s effervescent stuff

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the poem goes round the other pieces

blocks.note: an ode is a lyric poem
the Himalayas are an example of a mountain range, hence the question mark
A is the abbreviation for area

explanation.surface: A poem about a place east of the Himalayas, which turns out to be bubbly.
explanation.walkthrough: In an across clue, 'east of' means placed to the right of, so the area letter follows the mountain range.
explanation.definitionFit: Orangeade is a sweet fizzy soft drink flavoured with orange, so it bubbles.

clue.text: Store diamonds bagged by gutless accomplice for fence

indicators.note: something gutless has its insides removed, so only the outer letters remain
something bagged is put inside, so one piece goes into the other

blocks.note: stock is a store of goods
the first and last letters of the word
D is the abbreviation for diamonds in card games

explanation.surface: A shop's jewels are taken by a spineless criminal partner to sell to a receiver.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fence' suggests a dealer in stolen goods, fitting the criminal surface, but it is a barrier.
explanation.definitionFit: A stockade is a protective barrier made of upright wooden stakes, a type of fence.

clue.text: Primitive man brooking no delay

blocks.note: ur- is a prefix meaning original or primitive, as in Ur-text
a gent is a man

explanation.surface: A caveman who will not tolerate any waiting.
explanation.definitionFit: Something urgent demands immediate attention and so tolerates no postponement.
